quarterly_data.signal: NEC FY2026 (year to March 2026) results presentation (prepared remarks): revenue excluding the transfer of enterprise PC sales functions and the withdrawal from low-margin hardware grew 9% to JPY 3,582.7 billion; Non-GAAP operating profit rose JPY 85.9 billion to JPY 397.2 billion, a margin of 11%, the first time in double digits; adjusted operating profit rose JPY 99.7 billion to JPY 386.8 billion. BluStellar revenue grew 30% with profit up JPY 35.8 billion, both well above initial targets; domestic IT services orders rose 2% in Q4 and 1% for the year; aerospace and defense order intake reached just under JPY 600 billion; free cash flow rose JPY 258.9 billion to JPY 472.1 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue JPY 3,582.7 billion (+9%); Non-GAAP operating profit JPY 397.2 billion; A&D orders just under JPY 600 billion

quarterly_data.signal: NEC FY2027 (year to March 2027) forecast (prepared remarks): revenue JPY 3,500 billion and Non-GAAP operating profit JPY 420 billion, including an allowance of JPY 100 billion of revenue and JPY 30 billion of operating profit for component risks and macroeconomic uncertainty; the planned acquisition is not included. Domestic IT services revenue is expected to decline as public-sector projects (municipal standardization, fire and disaster prevention) peak out, with Non-GAAP operating profit up JPY 9.8 billion to JPY 312 billion (15.3% margin); BluStellar revenue up JPY 135 billion to JPY 840 billion and profit up JPY 41 billion to JPY 143 billion, toward FY March 2031 targets of JPY 1,300 billion revenue and a 25% margin; telecom services revenue JPY 355 billion (down JPY 35.5 billion) with profit up JPY 18.9 billion to JPY 48 billion; aerospace and defense profit up JPY 24.6 billion to JPY 79 billion as the submarine system business returns to profitability.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 revenue JPY 3,500 billion; Non-GAAP operating profit JPY 420 billion; BluStellar revenue JPY 840 billion
